subject.title: fix(sessions): cap in-memory session history to prevent unbounded growth

question: Should unpaginated Gateway session history become a fixed recent window of 500 projected messages, with older messages available only through explicit cursor pagination?
rationale: The implementation is technically plausible, but selecting a fixed implicit history boundary changes existing client-visible behavior and requires ownership of the compatibility tradeoff.

options.title: Approve bounded inline history
options.body: Accept the 500-message recent window after exact-head Gateway proof confirms refresh, append, and pagination transitions preserve accessible history.

options.title: Preserve current inline contract
options.body: Keep unpaginated behavior unchanged and move memory bounding entirely into the canonical transcript reader or an explicitly negotiated pagination contract.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded inline history
recommendation.body: Accept the 500-message recent window after exact-head Gateway proof confirms refresh, append, and pagination transitions preserve accessible history.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent transcript/core ownership makes this the best available routing candidate for the Gateway history compatibility decision.
